name: Sao Aphisith Sithisack
tagline: Junior EE student at the University of Oklahoma working on analog/mixed-signal IC design and silicon photonics.
homeIntro: Every project is written as a datasheet rather than a gallery: a parameter table with targets beside results, the test conditions those results were taken under, and the raw dataset behind each plot available for download. Where a number comes from a hand model rather than a simulator or from silicon, the page says so at the top.
aboutIntro: I care about the part of the job that happens after the first working simulation: corners, mismatch, what the measurement setup was, and whether a number survives contact with a spec table.
